name: Hesperian-Pingo
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Instruments disagree about the radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
